I replied to Pree in a thread on her #central-team message. I couldn't confirm that Brackenwater Freight Co.'s next renewal is on 8 April. None of the files I can see include a Brackenwater contract or CRM record. The Central team notes I could find don't mention the account at all.

So I treated the 8 April date as unconfirmed and didn't record it anywhere. In the reply, I suggested that the account owner or June Osei-Lark on the deal desk check it against the signed contract before anyone plans around it.
